checks.title: assetlinks.json reachable
checks.fix: Serve https://<rpId>/.well-known/assetlinks.json over HTTPS with status 200, Content-Type application/json and no redirects.

html.fix: Your site answered <url> with a web page (often a single-page app's catch-all route). Serve <file> before that route, or from your server, with status 200 and Content-Type application/json, and keep it out of folders a deploy mirrors or deletes.

checks.title: Login credentials delegated to the app
checks.fix: Add a statement with relation "delegate_permission/common.get_login_creds" for package <package> to assetlinks.json.

checks.title: Signing certificate listed
checks.fix: Add the SHA-256 fingerprint <fingerprint> (run ./gradlew passkiFingerprints) to sha256_cert_fingerprints for <package>.

checks.title: Google Digital Asset Links agrees
checks.fix: Google's Digital Asset Links API doesn't see the statement yet. Check the file is public and valid; Google may cache for a while.

checks.title: Play App Signing key listed
checks.fix: For Play releases, copy the App signing key SHA-256 from Play Console > Test and release > App integrity, and add it via passki { android { extraFingerprints.add("...") } }.

checks.title: PassKi initialised in the app
checks.fix: Keep PassKi's androidx.startup initializer, or call PasskiAndroid.init(application) in Application.onCreate().

checks.title: apple-app-site-association reachable
checks.fix: Serve https://<rpId>/.well-known/apple-app-site-association over HTTPS with status 200, JSON body and no redirects.

html.fix: Your site answered <url> with a web page (often a single-page app's catch-all route). Serve <file> before that route, or from your server, with status 200 and Content-Type application/json, and keep it out of folders a deploy mirrors or deletes.

checks.title: App listed under webcredentials
checks.fix: Add "<teamId>.<bundleId>" to webcredentials.apps in the apple-app-site-association file.

checks.title: Apple CDN has the app
checks.fix: Apple's CDN can lag up to 24h. While testing use webcredentials:<rpId>?mode=developer and enable Settings > Developer > Associated Domains Development.

checks.title: Entitlements list webcredentials
checks.fix: Add webcredentials:<rpId> to com.apple.developer.associated-domains in your .entitlements file (./gradlew passkiSetup writes it).

checks.title: Entitlements wired into the Xcode build
checks.fix: Set CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS = <path>.entitlements, e.g. in Configuration/Config.xcconfig (./gradlew passkiSetup does this without touching project.pbxproj).

checks.title: Built app carries the entitlement
checks.fix: The signed app does not contain the associated-domains entitlement. Rebuild after fixing IOS-05, and check signing (team, provisioning).

checks.title: Server RP ID matches
checks.fix: Configure your WebAuthn server's RP ID as <rpId>.

checks.title: Server allows all origins
checks.fix: Allow https://<rpId> and every android:apk-key-hash:<hash> origin printed by ./gradlew passkiFingerprints.

checks.title: Server options are valid WebAuthn
checks.fix: Registration options must include rp.id, a base64url challenge of at least 16 bytes and a user.id of 1-64 bytes.

checks.title: RP ID is a bare domain
checks.fix: Pass the relying party ID as a bare domain such as example.com: no scheme, port, path or query (the same value as the WebAuthn rp.id).

checks.title: Android device can store passkeys
checks.fix: Set a screen lock and sign in to a Google account (or enable another credential provider) in Settings.

checks.title: iOS device can use passkeys
checks.fix: Enrol Face ID/Touch ID (Simulator: Features > Face ID > Enrolled); for ?mode=developer enable Settings > Developer > Associated Domains Development.
